engine.version:
version: 0.3.0-dev (build 1, commit 662a0b0)
built with GNU 15.2.0 for Linux x86_64

adjacent_cuda_library.qualification: Adjacent library identity; not instrumentation of runtime dispatch.

context.reserve_basis: Total GPU memory minus the largest sampled total device use across final and preliminary baseline-setting probes; includes the desktop, does not sample all startup spikes or reserve memory against other applications.

prompt.limitation: Three fixed facts dispersed early, middle and late in repeated unrelated reference text, followed by one exact source edit; not general long-context accuracy or stability.

adherence.policy: Compare complete source after final </think> and optional single Python code fence; ignore only outer whitespace. Raw output retained. No code execution or semantic scoring.

limitations: One fixed retrieval/edit check passed at 61,440 input tokens; this is not general answer-quality or long-term stability validation.
Conversation reuse was checked only around 4K occupied tokens. Normal engine cache defaults remain unchanged; larger conversations may use more RAM or lose reuse.

engine.version:
version: 0.3.0-dev (build 1, commit 662a0b0)
built with GNU 15.2.0 for Linux x86_64

limitations: Cold uncached single-request synthetic coding workloads; no measured gain, quality or long-term stability claim.
Short workloads repeated twice; occupied-context workload run once. No context search was performed.
Peak GPU memory includes desktop usage; timings depend on this engine, template, GPU and driver.

summary: General coding with q8 conversation memory and MTP3; no general speedup established.

validation.cold_start: Every cold sample launched a fresh engine.

context_quality.scope: Three dispersed integer facts and one exact source edit, without executing generated code.

conversation.scope: Six controlled turns and six exact uncached replays, one repetition at 65,536 allocation and about 4K occupied input.
conversation.cache_policy: Evidence explicitly requests 8192 MiB and 32 checkpoints, matching this installed engine's advertised normal defaults. The recommended launch leaves both flags omitted; changed engines need revalidation.

validation.sampling_scope: GPU peaks cover sampled request execution, including the running desktop. Successful startup is observed; startup memory peaks are not fully sampled.

preliminary_validation.note: Initial instruction wording was revised after the MoE reached its 2048-token output cap. Both checkpoints were rerun with explicit right-hand-side assignment edits. This was not a context-memory failure.

prompt.limitation: Three fixed facts dispersed early, middle and late in repeated unrelated reference text, followed by one exact source edit; not general long-context accuracy or stability.

adherence.policy: Compare complete source after final </think> and optional single Python code fence; ignore only outer whitespace. Raw output retained. No code execution or semantic scoring.

decisions.decision: Keep physical batch512; the short1024 comparison did not establish a useful dense gain.
Target sampling and concurrent streams did not establish a useful dense gain.

Do not promote lookup as general or copy guidance: small-edit decode improved, generation regressed and copying was variable. Wider lookup also regressed. Source output counts differ; compare wall time and actual output too.
Keep q8/q8. Mixed q8/q4 was much slower with a small memory reduction on this installed build.

evidence_policy: Portable summaries retain source result IDs, budgets, actual counts and measured tradeoffs. Input token hashes use SHA256 of compact JSON integer arrays. Full raw records remain in the originating workbench; dated research is not local evidence.

decisions.decision: Keep physical batch512 and target sampling off: combined1024/sampling improved prefill modestly but reduced decode substantially. Isolated gains did not add together.
Physical batch1024 helped longer prefill but traded away decode and extra memory.
Small isolated sampling signal at a shorter prompt did not justify the final combined setting.
Concurrent streams did not establish a useful gain.
Lookup reduced decode on generation, copying and small edits. Shorter copy reasoning changes output count; it is not an equal-work speedup.
